data.action: 穿着宽松睡衣哼着歌准备早餐
data.camera: medium shot, turning bacon and fried eggs in a frying pan at the country stove
data.description: 【希露菲 · 新婚宅邸晨间】飘散着刚出炉面包香气的新家厨房里，希露菲穿着可爱的宽松居家服，一边哼着轻快的家乡小调一边熟练地翻动平底锅里的培根煎蛋。听到你的脚步声，她回过头笑靥如花——「早餐马上就好啦！快去洗手坐好，今天也为你准备了满满的能量哦！」
data.promptProse: Adult Sylphiette hums while turning bacon and fried eggs at the country stove, then looks toward the doorway with a radiant smile. Her oversized loose nightshirt retains the home outfit without changing the breakfast action. The medium view includes frying pan and bread along the kitchen counter. Soft morning window light illuminates white hair and pan edges, casting gentle utensil shadows over the counter and opening the shaded shirt folds near her hands.
data.title: 希露菲叶特 · 新婚宅邸晨间
